subject: Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District Amendment
overview: The Community Development Board voted to recommend proposed text amendments to the Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District and received updates on upcoming residential zoning amendments.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The Board entered executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation, New York Capital Investment Group, LLC v. City of Medford Community Development Board et al.

items.title: Election of Board Clerk
items.summary: The Board discussed the duties of the clerk but postponed the election to a future meeting because no members were nominated.

items.title: Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District Amendment
items.summary: The Board voted to recommend that the City Council approve proposed text amendments adjusting setbacks, green standards, and building coverage definitions, incorporating a minor language change to exclude the word 'cantilevered' from overhang rules.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Board tabled the approval of past meeting minutes because staff had not yet finished editing them.

items.title: Zoning Updates
items.summary: Staff announced upcoming public events for the neighborhood and urban residential zoning districts, as well as ongoing committee work regarding accessory dwelling units.
